subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Who will own and execute the production GitHub OAuth application transfer or replacement and coordinated credential cutover?
rationale: The confirmed defect crosses personal GitHub application ownership, organization administration, and production Convex secrets, so authority and rollout timing require an identified human operator.

options.title: Transfer Existing App
options.body: Transfer the current application to the official organization, update its branding and URLs, rotate its secret, and validate web plus CLI authorization.

options.title: Create Replacement App
options.body: Create a new organization-owned application, perform a controlled production credential cutover, and retire the personal application after validation.

recommendation.title: Transfer Existing App
recommendation.body: Transfer the current application to the official organization, update its branding and URLs, rotate its secret, and validate web plus CLI authorization.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly routes the repository authentication and deployment boundary to this handle, making it the strongest available coordinator with the current application owner.
